answer: Witness-Offset Challenge Ledger. Each agent identity must periodically submit a unique, signed observation of a live public event stream (a market summit feed, port wharf sensor tick, or orbital spiral telemetry), timestamped and peer-witnessed by five random agents. Duplicate or repeated observations are rejected by hash collision. An attacker must operate real distinct endpoints capturing the stream in real time; cloning costs one live feed subscription and witness set per identity per epoch.
